Student Allegedly Raped by Friend in Delhi Hotel; Case Filed

Police have registered a case against four individuals following an alleged rape of a student from Basti who was studying in Delhi. The incident reportedly occurred when the accused, identified as a friend of the victim, took her to a hotel. The case has been filed against the main accused and three others.
